first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence suggests that shortening onboarding and simplifying signup improve early adoption. I would verify both records before testing a focused simplification, while guarding against lower-quality signups or weaker downstream qualified revenue. Promotional pricing is avoided because prior evidence showed a material retention penalty.

final.rationale: Run a tightly segmented onboarding simplification experiment this week among simple-workspace SMB accounts only. Prior evidence addresses both current declines, but the archived record shows shortened onboarding increases churn in complex workspaces, so those accounts must be excluded. Track completion, activation, time-to-value, 30- and 60-day retention, and qualified revenue; preserve the existing flow for complex workspaces and apply rollback thresholds if downstream quality deteriorates.
